prompt: Back at home, Nadia wrote that the market opened (here) before sunrise.
explanation_ru: Надя пишет отзыв уже из дома, поэтому наречие места here при передаче её слов меняется на there.

prompt: Gran smiled: "I never add salt early." She told me (I) always waited.
explanation_ru: Бабушка говорит о себе, поэтому в косвенной речи местоимение I меняется на she.

prompt: The green parrot surprised me at the shop. Later, Kenji explained it had learned to say hello (last month).
explanation_ru: При пересказе слов в прошедшем времени выражение last month сдвигается на the month before или the previous month.

prompt: Hana wrote from the gym that our class didn't start ___ at seven.
options: here
there
at here
to there
explanation_ru: Хана писала из спортзала, а рассказчик находится в другом месте, поэтому here меняется на there. Частая ошибка — оставлять here или добавлять лишний предлог.

prompt: On Monday, the Zurich clerk called about my bag. On Tuesday, I told Mum he said it had arrived (this) morning.
explanation_ru: Служащий звонил в понедельник, а пересказ происходит во вторник, поэтому this morning меняется на that morning.

prompt: Camila and her little brother Rafael were waiting on the balcony of their flat in Rio. When she checked her phone, she sighed and warned Rafael that (our) father wouldn't get home early (tonight). She added that his office was too far from (here) to beat the evening traffic. Rafael quietly closed his colouring book and went to make sandwiches.
explanation_ru: Рассказ ведётся в третьем лице в прошедшем времени: our меняется на their, tonight — на that night, а here — на there.

prompt: After her trip, Mei wrote the night food shop didn't open here before dark.
answer: After her trip, Mei wrote the night food shop didn't open there before dark.
accepted_answers: After her trip, Mei wrote the night food shop didn't open there before dark.
After her trip, Mei wrote that the night food shop didn't open there before dark.
After her trip, Mei wrote the night food shop did not open there before dark.
explanation_ru: Мэй пишет уже после поездки, поэтому here нужно заменить на there. Типичная ошибка — оставлять here без изменения.

prompt: We walked to the wrong cinema gate first. A kind volunteer told (you) the outdoor film would begin (in ten minutes).
explanation_ru: Волонтёр обращалась к рассказчику и его спутнику (you → us), а в пересказе в прошедшем времени in ten minutes меняется на ten minutes later.

prompt: Priya welcomed me to the wedding and mentioned (we) always danced outside after sunset.
explanation_ru: Прия говорила о своей семье, а рассказчик — гость на свадьбе, поэтому we переходит в they.

prompt: In Oslo, the children stared quietly at the ancient wooden hull. After the tour, the retired fisherman Henrik explained that the ship had left ___ and never returned.
options: this harbour a thousand years ago
that harbour a thousand years ago
this harbour a thousand years before
that harbour a thousand years before
explanation_ru: После экскурсии и при глаголе в прошедшем времени (explained) сдвигаются оба слова: this → that и ago → before. Частая ошибка — изменить только одно из них.

prompt: Zofia and Klara wanted to try a sunrise yoga lesson at their hotel in Bali. After dinner, they bumped into the instructor in the lobby and asked about the morning schedule. She smiled and promised she would meet (you) on the sea terrace (tomorrow) at six. Both sisters set two alarms so they would not miss (this) class.
explanation_ru: В пересказе от третьего лица обращение к сёстрам you меняется на them, tomorrow — на the next/following day, а указательное слово this — на that.

prompt: On Monday, the Chicago manager told the drivers, "Your new training starts here at seven tomorrow." Two still missed it.
options: The manager announced that our new training started there at seven the next day.
The manager announced that their new training started here at seven tomorrow.
The manager announced that their new training started there at seven the next day.
The manager announced that your new training started there at seven the next day.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи от третьего лица нужно сдвинуть все три элемента: your → their, here → there и tomorrow → the next day.

prompt: The head teacher says the school bell rings five minutes earlier (today), so hurry!
explanation_ru: Глагол сообщения стоит в настоящем времени (says), а событие происходит прямо в этот же день, поэтому today сохраняется без сдвига.

prompt: Before leaving the outdoor stage in Jaipur, Vikram explained that the crowd would gather there by the fountain at sunset.
answer: Before leaving the outdoor stage in Jaipur, Vikram explained that the crowd would gather there by the fountain at sunset.
accepted_answers: Before leaving the outdoor stage in Jaipur, Vikram explained that the crowd would gather there by the fountain at sunset.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: наречие места there уже правильно сдвинуто для пересказа в прошедшем времени.

prompt: As a visitor in the Sri Lankan hills, I met a tea picker named Kavita. On the drive back, I recalled she had mentioned (my) family picked (these) leaves before the mist cleared.
explanation_ru: Кавита говорила о своей семье (my → her), а рассказчик вспоминает об этом уже на обратном пути вдали от плантации, поэтому these меняется на those.

prompt: A group of campers had set up their tents near a research station in northern Chile. At dusk, the astronomer Mateo walked over with a small telescope and announced that a bright comet would be visible from that hill (tonight). He admitted that (my) own camera didn't capture the tail well, so the campers shouldn't worry about taking photos. Instead, he invited them to join (me) over hot tea and watch the dark sky together.
explanation_ru: В повествовании в прошедшем времени слова астронома сдвигаются от первого лица к третьему: tonight → that night, my → his и me → him.

prompt: I went into a coat shop in Glasgow looking for a medium waterproof jacket. The assistant, Callum, checked the storeroom twice before coming back empty-handed. He warned me that the winter sale ended on Sunday and there wouldn't be any new sizes until (next month). However, he promised that if I left (your) phone number, (we) would call as soon as a medium arrived.
explanation_ru: При пересказе разговора в прошедшем времени next month меняется на the following/next month, обращение продавца к покупателю your — на my, а we (сотрудники магазина) — на they.

prompt: In March, Ji-hoon excitedly texted Min-seo from Seoul. Weeks later, she complained he had promised the game would launch ___.
options: in that country the next day
in this country tomorrow
in that country tomorrow
in that country next day
explanation_ru: Спустя недели и вдали от места события сдвигаются оба указателя: this → that и tomorrow → the next day. Типичная ошибка — оставить tomorrow или пропустить артикль the перед next day.

prompt: We ran across the hall, and Diego shouted (our) train left from platform nine.
explanation_ru: Рассказчик едет вместе с Диего (We ran), поэтому притяжательное местоимение our остаётся без изменения.

prompt: The Tokyo worker told two tourists ___ city train left five minutes later.
options: your
our
their
my
explanation_ru: Сотрудник станции обращался к двум туристам, а рассказчик говорит о них в третьем лице, поэтому your меняется на their. Частая ошибка — оставить your.

prompt: Tiago and Inês were heading to the beach when the receptionist hurried outside and warned them a storm would hit by nightfall, so (your) boards wouldn't be safe.
explanation_ru: Администратор обращалась к Тиагу и Инеш, а история передаётся от третьего лица, поэтому your переходит в their.

prompt: Nobody in the Stockholm office checked the calendar. Astrid had confirmed in her email that the furniture would arrive (next Tuesday).
explanation_ru: При передаче прошлого письма в косвенной речи next Tuesday меняется на the following Tuesday или the next Tuesday.

prompt: In April, a Riga worker said to Janis, "Our market moves to the riverside car park next Friday." → In April, the worker told Janis …
answer: In April, the worker told Janis their market moved to the riverside car park the following Friday.
accepted_answers: In April, the worker told Janis their market moved to the riverside car park the following Friday.
In April, the worker told Janis that their market moved to the riverside car park the following Friday.
In April, the worker told Janis their market moved to the riverside car park the next Friday.
In April, the worker told Janis that their market moved to the riverside car park the next Friday.
explanation_ru: Разговор произошёл в прошлом (In April), поэтому our меняется на their, глагол moves сдвигается в moved, а next Friday — в the following/next Friday.

prompt: During a lively cooking class in Lyon, Chef Luc noticed that Oliwia didn't know when to season the pot. He stepped over and instructed her to add the fresh herbs (now). Smiling at the group, he promised he would taste the soup (myself) (in half an hour). Oliwia finally relaxed and picked up the wooden spoon.
explanation_ru: В пересказе прошедшего занятия наречие now сдвигается в then, возвратное местоимение myself (от имени шефа) — в himself, а in half an hour — в half an hour later.

prompt: In the city, Linh told friends water filled (these) rice fields at night.
explanation_ru: Линь рассказывает о ферме уже находясь в городе, поэтому указательное местоимение these меняется на those.

prompt: Waiting at the airport, Samir complained the organiser had announced the rooftop film began here at eight, not nine.
answer: Waiting at the airport, Samir complained the organiser had announced the rooftop film began there at eight, not nine.
accepted_answers: Waiting at the airport, Samir complained the organiser had announced the rooftop film began there at eight, not nine.
Waiting at the airport, Samir complained that the organiser had announced the rooftop film began there at eight, not nine.
explanation_ru: Самир говорит уже в аэропорту, а не на крыше кинотеатра, поэтому here нужно заменить на there. Типичная ошибка — переносить here из прямой речи без сдвига.

prompt: In 2021, Claire and I spent hours talking in a Montreal café and didn't want to leave. Before stepping into the snow, she promised we would meet at that same table next year.
answer: In 2021, Claire and I spent hours talking in a Montreal café and didn't want to leave. Before stepping into the snow, she promised we would meet at that same table the following year.
accepted_answers: In 2021, Claire and I spent hours talking in a Montreal café and didn't want to leave. Before stepping into the snow, she promised we would meet at that same table the following year.
In 2021, Claire and I spent hours talking in a Montreal café and didn't want to leave. Before stepping into the snow, she promised that we would meet at that same table the following year.
In 2021, Claire and I spent hours talking in a Montreal café and did not want to leave. Before stepping into the snow, she promised we would meet at that same table the following year.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о встрече в 2021 году, поэтому next year в косвенной речи нужно заменить на the following year. Ошибка — оставлять next year без артикля и сдвига.

prompt: At a Portuguese castle, the guide told a group of retired teachers, "We will meet back at the main gate in forty-five minutes." Half of them didn't hear her while debating a portrait.
options: The guide reminded them that we would meet back at the main gate forty-five minutes later.
The guide reminded them that they would meet back at the main gate forty-five minutes later.
The guide reminded them that they would meet back at the main gate forty-five minutes before.
The guide reminded them that you would meet back at the main gate in forty-five minutes.
explanation_ru: При пересказе от третьего лица we переходит в they, а in forty-five minutes — в forty-five minutes later (а не before и не без сдвига).

prompt: Tarek arrived at a small hotel in Warsaw after midnight, hungry and tired. When he asked about food, the night porter apologised that the basement kitchen was closed. However, he reassured Tarek that (I) could make him a quick cup of tea and that breakfast opened at seven. He added that Tarek could help (yourself) to fruit in the lounge if he couldn't sleep.
explanation_ru: Ночной портье говорил о себе (I → he) и обращался к Тареку (yourself → himself), поэтому в пересказе от третьего лица оба местоимения меняются.

prompt: Petr phoned the driver on Monday and said he needed the wooden toys (today).
explanation_ru: Звонок был в понедельник, поэтому при пересказе позже слово today меняется на that day.

prompt: Our class got lost outside the Osaka music hall. Didn't Yuki tell us the concert began ___?
options: on this floor at half past six
on that floor at half past six
here on this floor at half past six
in that floor at half past six
explanation_ru: Класс находится снаружи, а не на нужном этаже, поэтому this меняется на that (on that floor). Частая ошибка — оставлять this или here либо выбирать предлог in вместо on.

prompt: My friend and I volunteered at a marine centre in Queensland during the autumn break. Before we drove to the coast, the lead diver Sienna emailed us to meet (me) by the wooden fence after dark. She asked us to bring spare torches because (mine) had run out of battery. She also warned us not to use phone lights so the baby turtles wouldn't notice (us) on the sand.
explanation_ru: Сиенна писала о себе и своих фонариках, поэтому me меняется на her, а mine — на hers. Местоимение us сохраняется, так как рассказчик и его друг тоже участвуют в наблюдении вместе с Сиенной.
